description:
Search project files with a regular expression: file, line and text of each match, with optional context lines and a result cap. Then read the part you need with summer_read_file.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/grep"}

context_lines.description: Lines of context before and after each match (0-10, default 0).

glob.description: File filter passed to ripgrep --glob, e.g. '*.gd', '**/*.json', '!addons/**'. A glob also reaches files .gitignore would skip.

max_line_chars.description: Clip every returned line to this many characters (default 240).

max_results.description: Most matches to return (default 50, max 500). truncated:true means there were more.

path.description: Search scope: a res:// directory or file, e.g. 'res://kit/' or 'res://kit/kit_manifest.json'. Default: the whole project.

name: summer_grep
title: Search project files
